core.title: St. Charles Robe Hook, Fusion RH-E5
tags: Fusion Saint Charles Collection Robe Hooks

text.description_html:
Fusion RH-E5, St. Charles Collection Robe Hook

The St. Charles Robe Hook features fleur-de-lis designs on the mounts, making it a great way to add old-world elegance to your home. It is available in either medium bronze or oil rubbed bronze finishes. This Robe hook is not only great for use in the bathroom, but also in many other rooms in your house as well. Hang a few in the closet for extra storage; and add a few by the front door to catch all the bags, hats, and coats that seem to always end up on the floor.

Also Available Matching: Fusion TB-E5 St. Charles Towel Bar, Fusion TR-E5 St. Charles Towel Ring, and Fusion PH-E5 St. Charles Toilet Paper Holder

Features and Specifications of the Fusion Saint Charles Collection Robe Hook:

  • Mount Diameter: 2-5/8"
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
